summary_en: Osaka Soda executed the purchase of 1.40 million shares at 1,951 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 11, 2026, resulting in an acquisition amount of approximately 2.73 billion yen, representing 1.2% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice of Share Acquisition through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Osaka Soda's Board of Directors authorized a share buyback program with an upper limit of 5.00 million shares (4.2% of outstanding shares) and a maximum expenditure of 5.0 billion yen, to be executed through November 11, 2026 to January 29, 2027 via on-exchange methods including ToSTNeT-3.

Under this program, the company executed its first block transaction on November 11, 2026. It purchased 1.40 million shares at a fixed price of 1,951 yen per share through the off-hours trading system (ToSTNeT-3) of the Tokyo Stock Exchange at 08:45 on the morning of November 11, 2026. The acquisition cost totaled approximately 2.73 billion yen.

This block execution represents 1.2% of the company's outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The purchase was conducted as a single order during the designated ToSTNeT-3 trading time slot, with the final results to be disclosed after the completion of that trading session.
